_doc: BRIDGE.EXE reel VO: the user's 10 lines (prompt §13), wording kept except where the picture would make a line untrue (line 6 names the change actually shown: truss height). Liam, Turbo v2.5, hi. Each line owns a window [t0, t1) and starts at t0 + lead. 'cap' = Roman Hinglish caption, 'tts' = what the voice reads (Devanagari Hindi + English words). Windows = the reel's sections on the 120 BPM grid (scripts/audio/timing_bridge.py writes SCENE_TIMINGS.json from them + the measured takes).

reel.cap: Bhai, AI se bridge model banwaya… phir uspar LOAD TEST chala diya!
reel.tts: भाई, AI से bridge model बनवाया… फिर उस पर LOAD TEST चला दिया!

reel.cap: Ye hai BRIDGE.EXE — Claude Opus 5.5 ke saath bani ek interactive engineering lab.
reel.tts: ये है Bridge dot E X E — Claude Opus five point five के साथ बनी एक interactive engineering lab.

reel.cap: Span aur truss ki geometry badlo, members drag karo… poora 3D model update!
reel.tts: Span और truss की geometry बदलो, members drag करो… पूरा three-D model update!

reel.cap: Ab load set karo, aur actual structural solver run karo — sirf animation nahi.
reel.tts: अब load set करो, और actual structural solver run करो — सिर्फ़ animation नहीं.

reel.cap: Dekho deflection, member forces, aur supports par reactions — sab model par visible.
reel.tts: देखो deflection, member forces, और supports पर reactions — सब model पर visible.

reel.cap: Truss ki height badlo… aur dono results compare karo. Kya difference hai!
reel.tts: ट्रस की height बदलो… और दोनों results compare करो. क्या difference है!

reel.cap: Aur Claude scripts likhke CAD aur reporting workflow bhi automate kar sakta hai.
reel.tts: और Claude scripts लिखकर CAD और reporting workflow भी automate कर सकता है.

reel.cap: Ek cinematic collapse mode bhi hai… lekin ye game effect hai, engineering prediction nahi!
reel.tts: एक cinematic collapse mode भी है… लेकिन ये game effect है, engineering prediction नहीं!

reel.cap: Real engineering decisions? Woh qualified engineers ko hi verify karne honge.
reel.tts: Real engineering decisions? वो qualified engineers को ही verify करने होंगे.

reel.cap: Civil engineers aur CAD users — comment karo CIVIL! Main tools aur repo links share karunga.
reel.tts: Civil engineers और CAD users — comment करो CIVIL! मैं tools और repo links share करूँगा.
